_comment: The only Microsoft runtime file shipped in the engine sidecar. Read by build-installer.ps1 (pin) and by the sidecar tests (provenance).

files.name: vcruntime140.dll
files.source: Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable vc_redist.x64.exe 14.52.37029.0 (https://aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.x64.exe), member vcruntime140.dll_amd64, extracted unmodified by desktop/tools/extract_vcruntime.py
files.minimum_reason: python314.dll and the extension modules record MSVC 14.44.35229 in their headers; Microsoft requires the redistributable to be the same or later than the build tools

removed_reason: Windows 10 and 11 provide the Universal CRT and always use their own copy
